name: Murapol S.A.
summary: Murapol S.A. engages in residential real estate development business in Poland. The company develops apartments and commercial projects. It also involved in robot construction related to the construction of residential buildings and non-residential, holding activities, marketing activities related to the sale of premises, and closed-end investment fund business, as well as provides related services with accounting and administration. Murapol S.A. was founded in 2001 and is based in Bielsko-Biala, Poland.
